reforms.description: The FILP reform aims to enhance the efficiency of special public institutions by requiring them to raise funds on financial markets, thereby promoting greater expenditure discipline. Additionally, the government has set an objective to increase the number of start-ups from 140,000 to 240,000 by creating an appropriate environment, including easier financing from public financial institutions.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The reforms are designed to improve funding mechanisms and support for startups, which are expected to enhance innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The startup ecosystem enhancement has been implemented, as indicated by the government's objective to increase the number of startups.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent significant structural changes aimed at improving public funding efficiency and fostering startup growth.
reforms.source_quote: The government has set an objective to increase the number of start-ups from 140,000 at present to 240,000 mainly by creating an appropriate environment including easier financing from public financial institutions.

reforms.description: The government has implemented a new law that grants 100% patent rights to private companies for projects sponsored by the government, encouraging R&D activities.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By granting full patent rights, the reform incentivizes private companies to engage in R&D, which can lead to increased innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The law has been implemented, as indicated by the granting of patent rights to private companies.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the reform is more focused and does not represent a systemic change like the FILP and startup support reform.
reforms.source_quote: Another scheme seeks to encourage R&D through granting 100 per cent patent rights to private companies for projects sponsored by the government.
